local.local-aws-bedrock-short-lived-key: Amazon Bedrock short-lived API key; gitleaks matches its fixed opening only, no body
local.local-azure-ad-client-secret: Azure AD client secret: three characters, a digit, Q~ and the body; gitleaks has no fixed prefix to open on
local.local-defined-networking-api-token: Defined Networking API token; gitleaks matches it only after a dnkey keyword
local.local-dropbox-short-lived-token: Dropbox short-lived token; gitleaks matches it only after a dropbox keyword
local.local-hashicorp-tf-api-token: Terraform Cloud token: an id, then .atlasv1., then the body; gitleaks has no fixed prefix to open on
local.local-mailgun-pub-key: Mailgun public validation key; gitleaks matches it only after a mailgun keyword
local.local-mailgun-signing-key: Mailgun webhook signing key: 32, 8 and 8 characters of a-h and digits; gitleaks matches it only after a mailgun keyword
local.local-mapbox-api-token: Mapbox token: pk., 60 characters, a dot and the rest; gitleaks matches it only after a mapbox keyword
local.local-new-relic-browser-api-token: New Relic browser API token; gitleaks matches it only after a new-relic keyword
local.local-new-relic-user-api-key: New Relic user API key; gitleaks matches it only after a new-relic keyword
local.local-sk-dash: `sk-` secret keys of many LLM vendors; gitleaks knows OpenAI's only by its marker
local.local-slack-a: Slack token with any body; the catalogue's rows need Slack's digit groups
local.local-slack-b: Slack token with any body; the catalogue's rows need Slack's digit groups
local.local-slack-p: Slack token with any body; the catalogue's rows need Slack's digit groups
local.local-slack-r: Slack token with any body; the catalogue's rows need Slack's digit groups
local.local-slack-webhook-services: Slack incoming webhook (services): everything after hooks.slack.com/services/ is the credential
local.local-slack-webhook-triggers: Slack incoming webhook (triggers): everything after hooks.slack.com/triggers/ is the credential
local.local-slack-webhook-workflows: Slack incoming webhook (workflows): everything after hooks.slack.com/workflows/ is the credential
local.local-stripe-publishable-key: Stripe publishable key, kept out of names written as code as before
local.local-teams-webhook: Microsoft Teams incoming webhook: everything after webhookb2/ is the credential
local.local-teams-webhook-legacy: Microsoft Teams incoming webhook, the older outlook.office.com/webhook/ host
local.local-teams-webhook-legacy-365: Microsoft Teams incoming webhook, the older outlook.office365.com/webhook/ host
local.local-telegram-bot-token: Telegram bot token, the bot id then :A and the body, named or not (also glued to /bot in an API URL)
local.local-typeform-api-token: Typeform personal token; gitleaks matches it only after a typeform keyword
local.local-yandex-access-token: Yandex OAuth token: t1., an id, a dot and an 86-character body; gitleaks matches it only after a yandex keyword

policy: body sets: digits and each letter case completed; last set: unbounded, minimum lowered to 16 where upstream's is longer

skipped.sentry-org-token: some branches: a body set holds a space, a quote or nothing
